Do not open this issue unless the ecosystem has agreed to be named. Leave the name blank and say so if that agreement is not public yet.

### Ecosystem

Name and a public URL. Do not invent a treasury, a budget, or a commitment.

### Which starting point

The treasury quickstart names three starter programs and one replenishment instrument. Say which of those this request is about.

### What the ecosystem can show in public

Link receipts, minutes, or other public records. A point score is not evidence for a hard gate.

### Contact

How a maintainer should reply in public. Do not put a private phone number here.
